evals.name: Agent completion notification
evals.prompt: Send Andy a completion notification for this run. Workspace is /Users/andrewho/repos/projects/auth, branch codex/auth-fix, PR https://github.com/anmho/auth/pull/12, checks passed: bun test and bun run typecheck.
evals.expected_output: Uses the notifications skill to send or prepare a concise Resend email to andyminhtuanho@gmail.com from Agent <agent@anmho.com>, includes workspace path, branch, PR, checks, and completion status.
assertions: Uses andyminhtuanho@gmail.com as the default recipient
Uses Agent <agent@anmho.com> or agent@anmho.com as the sender
Includes workspace path, branch, PR, and checks in the notice
Uses Resend for the email channel
Does not ask for a recipient before proceeding

evals.name: Vault-backed Resend credentials
evals.prompt: How should the agent get credentials to email me with Resend without leaking secrets?
evals.expected_output: Reads RESEND_API_KEY from env if present, otherwise uses vault kv get -mount=secret -field=api_key prod/providers/resend, and never prints Vault tokens or API keys.
assertions: Mentions RESEND_API_KEY as an environment override
Says not to print or paste secrets
Does not hardcode a Resend API key

evals.name: No send without explicit notification request
evals.prompt: Draft the email you would send when this agent run finishes, but do not send it.
evals.expected_output: Drafts a completion email using the template fields and explicitly avoids sending a real Resend request because the user asked not to send.
assertions: Does not call Resend or claim a message was sent
Includes completion-template fields like status, workspace, checks, blockers, and next action
Mentions that a real send requires an explicit send/notify request

evals.name: Should not apply to iMessage workflow
evals.prompt: Send an iMessage to Andy with the BlueBubbles CLI saying the run finished.
evals.expected_output: Uses BlueBubbles CLI guidance rather than Resend email, Vault Resend credentials, or the notifications email flow.
assertions: Does not use Resend for an iMessage request
